headline: Branch claude/business-state-issues-42vql1 — 31 commits, all pushed, merged up to main's 0.13.1. Guardrail sweep 50 PASS / 3 FAIL / 1 NO-DATA (from 15 red), no error-severity failures left. The through-line: almost nothing red was a code defect, it was gates measuring something that had moved. The docs gate read 11 doc-site pages ADR-018 deleted, so 0 of 104 was arithmetic, not coverage. check-validator-wiring read a ci.yml COMMENT as CI wiring — 7 of its 8 drifts were that one comment, and the registry it accused was correct. check-motion did not know Tailwind transition-colors, so it called Tag motionless while Tag animates. check-token-paths-ratchet was reading a derivation bug: hds.* bridge aliases (space.px4 is --primitive-space-1) were passed through as primitive keys. Three gates audited spec files, reporting the literals a test exists to pin. Exemption markers went invisible whenever their reason wrapped to a second line. NEW THIS SESSION: pnpm figma:disposition computes the real code-to-Figma parity target — 88 library / 18 slot / 14 layout / 19 internal, so the gap is 41, not the 95 that figma:links --check implies. stagingFileKey is set and the duplicate is verified faithful, so agents finally have a legal Figma write target.
next: PILOT: draw StatusDot into the staging copy (2VgBbVpKiDnu0aftJEVyBQ) from the manifest, via the Figma MCP. Smallest surface in the missing-41. If an agent can draw one correctly, the other 40 are mechanical; if not, an hour is lost rather than a week. This is the 'AI builds components in my design system' goal made concrete

#235 is the gate on everything Figma: ratify or redline the disposition table. Three yes/no calls, not 139 — (1) are the 14 layout primitives correctly out, (2) are the 18 slots correctly out, (3) should all 41 be drawn or is some dead weight. Recommendations are in the issue comment. Default applies 2026-10-03

Build order for the 41 once ratified: Tier 1 Icon/Token/Text (25/17/16 internal consumers and NONE is in Figma — median for components that ARE in Figma is 3, so this is the real hole). Tier 2 the date/time family (5, one Calendar drawing plus input variants) and the overlays (5, all share Dialog's shell). Tier 3 question first — StackedCardRail, CinematicLink, TextLockup overlap #133's right-sizing audit

Then the two MDX pages in Storybook: a stack walkthrough and 'Using HDS with an AI agent'. .storybook/main.ts already globs src/stories/**/*.mdx and there are ZERO mdx files — the docs surface is wired and empty. The agent page is the differentiator: llms.txt + hds-manifest.json + component-api.json is an agent-legible DS almost nobody else ships

17 check-tier-bypass violations: components reading var(--primitive-*) with no semantic alias to reach for. semantic.size and semantic.zIndex do not exist; component.* covers 7 components and none of these. Recommendation in #242: add 3 semantic families (zIndex named layers first — smallest, most obviously correct), not 6 component groups
#249 — gate the record artifacts so status.json and .changeset cannot silently go stale. The api-baseline was 81 commits stale for exactly this reason
68 baselined check-token-paths-ratchet violations remain (down from 72). Burn down via unit 12g
Tooltip (93:15) is the last unmapped Figma asset, on purpose: Figma publishes Tooltip, the code Tooltip is an @internal image-hover utility. Rename one side or accept it

The manifest's consumer scanner counts a component NAME IN A COMMENT as a dependency — same comment-blindness fixed in check-validator-wiring this session. Produced one false edge, worked around, not chased
blocked: Adrian: the Figma PAT in the remote container is DEAD — HTTP 403 on /v1/files for the staging copy AND for the published library, so it is the token, not the file. Rotate at https://www.figma.com/settings (Security -> Personal access tokens) with the file_content:read scope. Without it pnpm figma:inventory, check:figma-drift and any REST verification cannot run. The Figma MCP still works, so a drawing pilot is NOT blocked by this — only the gates are

Adrian: Storybook is live at https://hirobius-design-system.vercel.app but SSO-GATED (ssoProtection all_except_custom_domains), so only you can open it. For a portfolio piece aimed at the Figma community that is the whole ballgame. Fix: https://vercel.com/adrian-6234s-projects/hirobius-design-system/settings/deployment-protection -> Vercel Authentication -> Disabled -> Save. Then set storybookUrl in figma/links.json (currently null, so every design-to-code link points at raw GitHub files instead of the rendered story)
Adrian: #235 — ratify or redline the disposition table (see next[] above). Everything Figma waits on this

Adrian: #236 — commit the first figma/snapshot.json. Import figma/push/plugin/manifest.json in Figma desktop, run 'Plan push (dry run)' against the COPY (2VgBbVpKiDnu0aftJEVyBQ) not the published library, then Take snapshot. Unblocks TWO gates: check-figma-drift (NO-DATA) and check-link-integrity's 5 remaining doc-refs. Read the plan before pushing — the variables were generated by an older tool of ours (see #250), so the first push reconciles two generations, not hand-work against automation

Adrian: #126 — CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN in Actions secrets + CHROMATIC_ENABLED=true in Actions variables. Triggers are already restored on main; the CHROMATIC_ENABLED guard is all that is missing, so 139 components are merging with no visual review

Adrian: two community UI kits (Material 3 Design Kit, Simple Design System) are subscribed to the HDS Figma file, so every design-system search returns their components alongside ours. Figma -> Assets panel -> book icon -> toggle both off
